_info: Custom English string overrides for Lullex WiFi Provisioning.
_usage: These strings are NOT automatically applied by the build system.
1. A reference for YAML text fields already set in lullex.yml
2. A source for updating i18n/en.po entries for full UI translation
3. A migration guide when upstream strings change
To apply UI-level overrides: update matching msgid/msgstr in i18n/en.po
